notes.title: Version 1.5.0.0 Release
notes.notes:
Hey, it's been awhile.  After some recent messages, I was informed about some gameplay issues, and decided to address them.  The changes are as follows:


 Klein's Kartenmischens has fewer invulnerable frames on start.
 Bryan's Deathly Slam has fewer invulnerable frames on start.
 The height of Bryan's crouch idle hurtbox increased slightly.
 HW's Blazing Dash has fewer invulnerable frames on start.
 Arvid can only perform two instances of Belly of Steel per combo.


This is a rather small list, but if more infinites and issues are brought to my attention, I'll see what I can do.  These updates are only present in the PC version for now.  It may be awhile before an XB1 patch can be made -- if ever sadly, :\.

If you find more issues, feel free to email [noparse]support@mattrifiedgames.com[/noparse] or join the Mattrified Games discord:  https://discord.com/invite/VeaU9bg (make sure to read the rules channel first.)
